intro.heading: Building reliable backend systems for complex products
intro.summary: I’m Hrvoje, an engineer and founder in Split, Croatia.
paragraphs: I’ve spent more than 13 years building software across automotive, healthcare, media and commerce. I like getting close to a problem, understanding the people around it and seeing the work through to production.
These days I work on Tilt’s backend and build my own products through HILLS Lab. I use AI every day for research, implementation and operations, with the same responsibility for the result.

work.heading: Work, today.
work.description: At Tilt, I work on the backend behind livestream commerce: auctions, payments, shipping and the systems connecting them.

capabilityAreas.title: Understand the problem first
capabilityAreas.intro: Read the code, talk with the team and make the scope clear before committing to a solution.

capabilityAreas.title: Stay with the change
capabilityAreas.intro: Design, implementation, debugging and release are connected. I care about how the system behaves after it ships.

capabilityAreas.title: Leave useful context
capabilityAreas.intro: Explain the decisions, document the awkward parts and help the next person pick up the work.

highlightedWork.name: HILLS Lab
highlightedWork.summary: The four-person engineering studio I founded. We build our own products and help other software teams with backend engineering and delivery.

highlightedWork.name: PLAYGRND
highlightedWork.summary: A home for local football. Alongside engineering, I work with organisers and players, support users and build the community around the product.

journey.heading: How I got here.
journey.summary: From on-site enterprise delivery to remote founder partnerships, the through-line has been building systems people can trust.

stops.headline: Learning by shipping
stops.summary: Freelance web and mobile work alongside my computer science studies at FESB. More than 3,000 hours of real projects before graduating.

stops.headline: Enterprise, product teams and cars
stops.summary: Ericsson, Profico and Rimac: internal tools, client products, distributed services, vehicle telemetry and over-the-air updates.

stops.headline: Remote teams and my own products
stops.summary: Healthcare work through Povio, gaming infrastructure at ReneVerse, consulting for CryptoToday and now live commerce at Tilt. Alongside that, growing HILLS Lab and building PLAYGRND, Memoato and other products.

life.heading: Away from the keyboard.
life.summary: My life revolves around family, software, and fitness. Sound money keeps the long-term view honest.

focusAreas.title: Family
focusAreas.description: I’m a father of two. School runs, evening routines and time together are a big part of life outside work.

focusAreas.title: Football and movement
focusAreas.description: Football, padel, the gym and cycling keep me moving. PLAYGRND also gets me out talking with players and organisers at local events.

focusAreas.title: The long view
focusAreas.description: I follow Bitcoin and the idea of sound money. I’m interested in things that stay useful over time, in software and outside it.

principles.heading: What I value.
items: Make the system understandable for the people who use and maintain it.
Work with the people who will live with the result.
Share what I learn through mentoring, documentation and field notes.

training.heading: Training snapshot
training.summary: Autumn focus: reclaim conditioning while protecting long-term joints. Consistency beats intensity.
